title: Proposal Microsite
subtitle: Turn a prospect brief into an interactive deal summary your client actually wants to read.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: 5 sheets: Company Profile ($2.4B revenue, decision timeline), Stakeholders (4 named decision-makers + objections), Pain Points ($47M impact), ROI Model (3-year, 215%), Case Studies (2 aerospace references)
1-page battle card: Genpact vs Accenture, objection handlers for Robert Chen's failed implementation concern, pricing comparison
Genpact brand logo — attach so the AI embeds it in the microsite header
Design system: dark navy background, blue/gold accents, card surface treatment — attach so the AI matches this visual standard
Target microsite layout: hero ROI section above fold, tab-strip stakeholder cards, case study section — attach so the AI matches this layout

learning_objectives: Frame the deal before writing any prompt — decide what Robert Chen needs to believe and what decision he must make
Write your own AI prompt using a 5-area scaffold: audience, data, design, what to build, output rules
Test your first output against the data file — verify at least 3 figures before you iterate
Improve with one targeted follow-up instead of re-prompting from scratch
Deliver a self-contained HTML microsite a sales rep can open on a laptop in any client meeting — no server, no install, no dependencies
